technique_name: Explain what a "convoluted neural network" is and how it differs from a regular neural network.
description: A convolutional neural network (CNN) is a type of artificial neural network that uses convolutional layers to explore the spatial relationships in the input data. Unlike regular neural networks, which are fully connected and accept input vectors of any length, CNNs have a restricted connectivity pattern and operate on fewer parameters. This makes them well-suited for processing complex, multi-dimensional inputs such as images. Convolutional layers allow the network to identify different features
